prompt.alinti: You can now turn Claude into an insane AI designer with 5 free tools.
The first is Taste. It gives Claude actual design rules to follow, so you stop getting those generic AI-looking websites.
Second is Impeccable. It improves your front-end designs using its own design system, and even gives you a live editor to make changes directly in your browser.
Third is Playwright CLI. Claude can spin up multiple browsers and automatically test your website and take screenshots to make sure everything actually works and looks good.
Fourth is Awesome Design. It gives Claude design systems inspired by real websites, including their typography, their spacing, their buttons, and their layouts.
And finally is Image23JS. Give it an image of something, and Claude can recreate it as an interactive 3D model entirely through code.
And all five are completely free.
